item.title: Senate passes bill raising corporate tax rate to 25% after loophole review
item.author: Jane Reporter
item.description: The Senate voted 52-48 to raise the corporate tax rate to 25 percent while closing several loopholes identified in a GAO review. Critics say the change will slow hiring.

item.title: Pentagon audit finds $3 billion in unaccounted procurement spending
item.description: A Government Accountability Office audit found the Pentagon could not account for $3 billion in contractor payments across six failed programs.

item.title: Tech firm replaces 1,200 customer service jobs with AI agents
item.description: The company said generative AI agents now handle most support tickets; laid-off workers will receive retraining stipends.
